messages:
ops-bot: Pager triggered — gen-query error-rate spike in us-west (streaming responses). Link: https://pager.example/INC-6123

devon: I'm oncall, pulling up graphs now.

sara: Observability — any estimate of customer impact? @devon

devon: Prelim: 2-3% of streaming requests returning 5xx, tail latency up to 800ms for a subset of genqueue workers.

alex: Is this correlated with a deploy or autoscaling event? Logs show repeated kv-cache misses around 03:12 UTC.

devon: No recent deploys in us-west. Looks like a process-level OOM pattern on gen-worker-*/g5x nodes. I'm starting a mitigation plan.

devon: Mitigation steps: 1) enable fallback routing for heavy streams -> small-model-quant, 2) scale genqueue by +3 workers in us-west, 3) restart two suspect workers behind drain.

ops-bot: Autoscale request sent to infra: +3 genqueue workers (req 6123-A). Restart queued for worker-3 and worker-7.

sara: I'll draft a quick statuspage initial update. Keep it succinct — focus on impact, scope, and next update time.

devon: Good. Also add "no data loss" and note that embeddings/embeddings-v1 endpoints unaffected.

maria: I'll handle CS notification template once the status copy is approved. Need severity tag — do we classify as partial degradation? @alex

alex: Yes: "Partial degradation — increased errors and latency for streaming in US-West." Add ETA for next update in 15m.

devon: Status update draft pasted below:

```Initial update (prelim)
Time: 03:18 UTC
Summary: We are investigating elevated error rates and increased tail latency affecting streaming generation in the US-West region. Some requests may see 5xx errors or delayed responses.
Impact: ~2-3% of streaming requests in US-West; non-streaming and embedding endpoints not impacted.
Customer guidance: Retry transient errors; automated retries will succeed for most requests. No data loss reported.
Mitigation: Routing to a fallback smaller model and scaling genqueue workers is in progress.
Next update: ~15 minutes
```

sara: LGTM aside from tightening language: change "retry transient errors" -> "please retry; we've increased automatic retries where applicable".

devon: Updated draft with the wording.

maria: CS template ready to go once publish approved:
"We’re seeing partial degradation of streaming generation in US-West. Engineers are actively mitigating; we expect improvements within the hour. No customer data was lost. For updates: [status page link]."

ir-bot: Legal/Compliance notified per runbook.

alex: Can someone take publish duty? Maria, you ok to publish initial & then handoff to Sara for 15m updates?

maria: I can publish initial. Sara will post follow-ups. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Statuspage draft submitted to statuspage-provisioner (job 6123-SP) — pending publish approval.

maria: Published initial status page at 03:22 UTC. Link: https://status.redwood.example/incident/6123

sara: I'll post a follow-up at 03:37 UTC or earlier if mitigation completes. Please post short notes on any customer escalations here.

devon: Restarted worker-3 and worker-7; both rejoined genqueue pool. Error rate dropped to ~0.8% — continuing to monitor.

maria: Noted reduction. Updating customer message to note "improvements observed".

sara: Follow-up draft (03:37 UTC):

```Update 1
Time: 03:37 UTC
Summary: Mitigations in progress; error rates have decreased following worker restarts and routing to fallback model.
Impact: Error rate reduced to ~0.8% in US-West, tail latency improving. Some intermittent errors may persist.
Recovery steps: Continued autoscale and health checks; engineers monitoring.
Next update: 30 minutes or when resolved.
```

alex: Good. Are we ready to mark resolved if metrics return to baseline in the next 10m? Anyone want to prep resolved copy now?

devon: If error <0.5% and latency normalized for 10m, I'll sign off.

ops-bot: Metrics: error-rate time-series shows steady decline; 10m rolling avg at 0.45% now.

devon: OK, I consider it recovered. No further action required on routing.

maria: Resolved notice draft:

```Resolved
Time: 03:55 UTC
Summary: The issue causing elevated error rates and latency for streaming generation in US-West has been resolved. Metrics have returned to baseline.
Impact: Affected a small subset of streaming requests (~2-3% at peak). No customer data loss.
What we did: Restarted two genqueue workers, routed heavy streams to fallback model, and scaled genqueue capacity.
Next steps: Postmortem with root-cause analysis and remediation plan (link coming).
```

sara: I'll publish resolved notice and notify CS that the incident is closed from an ops perspective.

maria: Resolved published at 03:56 UTC. CS notified.

alex: Nice work team. We'll track a follow-up postmortem in #postmortems and assign owners.

devon: Filing RCA ticket 6123-RCA.

maria: Closing incident channel. Thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
